citations.claim: cart exceeds +2.4 track limit at first violating step
cart was still inside track one step before, showing gradual drift exit

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise to 0.0; without noisy angle measurements the biased cart drift disappears and the cart stays on track

explanation: With seeded sensor noise on pole-angle measurements the state-feedback controller integrates a biased correction that produces a slow steady cart drift (+v ~0.85-1.37 m/s) while keeping the pole upright (theta~0.08 rad). Starting from x=0.14, v=0.37 the drift accumulates over ~5.1s until |x| exceeds 2.4. Removing only the noise removes the drift and the violation.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.402 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart has drifted to the far right end of the track while the pole remains nearly upright. From step 2382 to 2385 it stays at the edge and creeps beyond the limit.
